unit.unitinstructions:
🌐 Countries of the World

Practice naming 200 active country maps drawn from a larger image bank, giving you broad geography coverage without making the first pass too heavy.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a simplified country outline or locator image, and you type the country name from memory.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Feedback appears immediately after every response, so you can connect the visual shape to the correct name right away.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings uncertain countries back sooner and spaces familiar ones farther apart for stronger long-term map memory.

Use the outline, region, coastline, and neighboring shapes as clues, then begin when you are ready.
